content.value: Ailments are status effects that can be inflicted through elemental and physical damage. Each damage type has associated ailments that trigger based on the damage dealt.

• Bleed — Deals physical damage over time. Stacks in intensity based on the hit that caused it. Moving while bleeding increases damage taken.
• Poison — Deals chaos damage over time. Can stack multiple times from separate hits.

• Burn (Fire) — Deals fire damage over time. Caused by fire damage. Duration and damage scale with the initial hit.
• Freeze (Cold) — Slows movement and attack speed. Caused by cold damage. Stronger hits cause longer freezes.
• Shock (Lightning) — Increases damage taken from all sources. Caused by lightning damage.
• Electrocute (Lightning) — Deals lightning damage over time. A secondary lightning ailment.

Ailments are applied based on the elemental damage dealt relative to the target's maximum health. Higher damage relative to HP means a stronger ailment effect. Resistances reduce both the direct damage and the ailment's severity.
Elemental resistances are your best defense against ailments. Even if you can't avoid the hit, high resistance significantly reduces the ailment's impact.
